get.summary:
Effective organization-scope permission keys for the authenticated user.
Frontend uses this for action visibility only; the backend remains the
authorization authority (ADR 0010).

Effective workspace-scope permission keys for the authenticated user:
organization-wide grants (workspace_id IS NULL at organization scope)
plus grants bound to this workspace. Mirrors the authorize_workspace
join semantics so workspace-scoped project roles surface correctly.
Frontend uses this for action visibility only (ADR 0011).

Member directory (STEP 21C): only users that would currently satisfy
assignment eligibility — active user, active organization membership,
active workspace membership. Access gate is the ordinary workspace
context: any legitimate workspace member may see member names (operational
metadata); the write path alone requires processes:assign.

AssigneePublic.description:
Minimal public identity of a process assignee (STEP 21C, ADR 0018).
`eligible` reports whether the assignee still satisfies membership/user
activation rules — a stale assignee remains displayed for history but
must not be presented as an active member.

cancel_reason.description: Optional bounded note explaining why the attempt was abandoned.

token.description:
Raw invitation token. Shown ONCE at creation because email delivery
is not built yet; list endpoints never return it. The inviter is
responsible for delivering it to the recipient over a trusted channel.

expires_in_hours.description: Optional expiration in hours; defaults to 72, bounded to 720.

parent_section_id.description: Optional parent; omitted or null creates a ROOT section.

server_time.description: Authoritative server timestamp for client clock-offset correction.

assignee_user_id.description:
Responsibility snapshot (STEP 21C, ADR 0018): who the process was
assigned to when this attempt began. Written once at INSERT, never
updated; distinct from the actor fields above.

oneOf.description:
Current responsible user; `null` means unassigned. Assignment is
responsibility metadata, never authorization (ADR 0018).

Progress.description: Derived progress for one scope — never persisted (ADR 0017).

active.description: Counted definitions with an execution currently in flight.

completed.description: Counted definitions satisfying DONE (∃ completed ∧ ¬∃ active).

percent.description:
Backend-authoritative integer percent (round-half-up, integer math).
NULL exactly when total = 0 — never a fake 0 or 100.

total.description: All counted definitions in the scope.

progress.description:
Derived project progress (ADR 0017) — never a column; handlers attach
the real aggregate before serialization.

process_ids.description: Every active process of the work item, exactly once, in the desired order.

progress.description:
Derived subtree progress (ADR 0017) — never a column; handlers attach
the real aggregate before serialization.

start_reason.description: Optional bounded note for operational history (covers retry reasons).

user_id.description:
A workspace-member user id to assign, or `null` to unassign. The key
itself is required — an omitted `user_id` is a malformed request
(400), never a silent unassign.

description.description: Empty string clears the stored description.

status.description: Only `archived` changes state; archive is terminal in this V1 API.

UpdateProjectRequest.description:
Ownership (tenant/workspace) and lifecycle authority never enter the body:
scope comes from the authenticated session plus the route, and new
projects always start `active` (ADR 0011).

description.description: Empty string clears the stored description.

parent_section_id.description: Absent = keep; null = become a root section; UUID = reparent.

position.description: Sibling order; ignored when absent (a reparent appends instead).

progress.description:
Derived on read (ADR 0017) — never a column; handlers attach the real
aggregate before serialization.

WorkspaceMemberPublic.description:
Minimal member identity for the assignee picker (STEP 21C, ADR 0018):
id + display name only — no email, roles, or membership internals.
